notes.title: Shadow of the Groundhog will be available soon!
notes.notes:
The Groundhog Day is coming, so Freddy the Groundhog will be awaken by unblushing people… Get ready, help little creature to find a way out of his hole. Sounds easy, huh? His hole is a real maze, moreover it is full of light, nonetheless Freddy should not see his own shadow, otherwise he would get scared and turn back… Then your effort was in vain! Be careful, pass over light sources!
We hope you enjoy the game about a cute little groundhog and it will predict only the coming spring.
Do not forget to leave a review about the game!
WonderBox Games Team.
